Definition: from G2596 and G4126; to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land at:--arrive.
BiblicalUsage: They arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the landing matters, because the man in the tombs was waiting on the other side.
